description: This source file defines classes and functions related to theming styles in the rich library, including Theme, ThemeStack, and handling of theme configuration files.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: A container for style information used by the rich console, capable of loading from files or dictionaries, and generating configuration strings.

classes.name: ThemeStack
classes.description: Manages a stack of themes, allowing push and pop operations with inheritance options.

classes.name: ThemeStackError
classes.description: Exception raised for errors related to theme stack operations.

methods.description: Returns a string representing the theme's configuration in ini format.

methods.name: Theme.from_file
methods.description: Loads a Theme from an open configuration file.

methods.name: Theme.read
methods.description: Reads a Theme from a file path.

methods.name: ThemeStack.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a ThemeStack with a base Theme.

methods.name: ThemeStack.push_theme
methods.description: Pushes a new theme onto the stack with optional inheritance.

methods.name: ThemeStack.pop_theme
methods.description: Removes the top-most theme from the stack.
